title: cli: os meta register can save a draft, and os lint can judge one item
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「三点都同意，按最终计划把后续里程碑的卡全部立出来」, and, on the list of thirteen cards the seat then showed: 「同意」. The ruling records are #34659 comment 6940528935 and #34691 comment 6943107981. Readings: objectstack `a0326b06`, cloud `53a5844`, 2026-11-17.

## Why

The code-first path can only save a live item, and can only lint a whole project. A client that builds one item at a time has no fast local check and no way to stage for review from the command line.

Who acts: the server lane (`packages/cli`). Reader: a developer or an AI client working item by item.

## Evidence

- `os meta register` declares no flag for `mode`: "adding one is a separate widening" (`packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register.ts:75-76`). It saves an active item.
- `os lint` takes a configuration file and lints the whole stack (`packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts:905-1071`).

## Scope

- `os meta register --mode draft` stages a draft through the same REST route with `?mode=draft` and prints the publish verdict.
- `os lint --item <file> --type <type>` runs the rules that can judge one item alone, and says which rules it could not run without the rest of the stack.

## Done when

- Both commands work against a self-hosted runtime with an API key; a draft staged this way appears in Studio's Changes.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Ruling: E4 = A (the local path uses an API key).
- Dedup, open and closed: `os lint --item` none.
